description: NaBaVF₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.92 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.86 Å. There are two inequivalent Ba sites. In the first Ba site, Ba is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten F atoms. There are a spread of Ba-F bond distances ranging from 2.66-3.27 Å. In the second Ba site, Ba is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten F atoms. There are a spread of Ba-F bond distances ranging from 2.65-3.31 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of V-F bond distances ranging from 1.96-1.99 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of V-F bond distances ranging from 1.96-1.99 Å. There are twelve inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ba, and one V atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ba, and one V atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ba, and one V atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ba, and one V atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ba, and one V atom. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ba, and one V atom. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ba, and one V atom. In the eighth F site, F is bonded to two Na, one Ba, and one V atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FBaNa₂V trigonal pyramids. In the ninth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ba, and one V atom. In the tenth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ba, and one V atom. In the eleventh F site, F is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ba, and one V atom. In the twelfth F site, F is bonded to two Na, one Ba, and one V atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FBaNa₂V trigonal pyramids.
